msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.entered_subti: Please gamble responsibly. Or at least entertainingly.
gui.burmaldaholic.croupier.title: Croupier
dialog.burmaldaholic.croupier.greeting.1: Welcome! The tables are warm and the odds are… fair. Mostly.
dialog.burmaldaholic.croupier.greeting.2: Feeling lucky? A scratch card is a gentle start.
dialog.burmaldaholic.croupier.greeting.3: Hrm. (The croupier adjusts his bow tie meaningfully.)
dialog.burmaldaholic.piglin_dealer.greet: Snort! Gold on the table, gold in the pocket. Mine, mostly.
You wear no gold. Bold. The dice don't care.
House rules: no mining the tables. Everything else — allowed.
dialog.burmaldaholic.shulker_croupier.gr: (The shulker opens its shell just enough to take your bet.)
High rollers only. You'll float out if you lose. Joke. Mostly.
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.found_: Nearest casino: %1$s at %2$s (%3$s m, %4$s). Nobody has been there yet
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.none: No casino within %1$s m. Try further out
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.none_k: No known casino in this dimension
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.wrong_: No casinos here. Look in villages, bastions and End Cities
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.mode_o: Casino mode is off in this world
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.cooldo: The casino scout is catching his breath. Try again in %1$s s
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.player: Only players can look for casinos
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.busy: Casino scouts are busy right now. Try again in a moment
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.none_p: No casino found within %1$s m, but the search was cut short. Try again
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.cut_sh: (search cut short: there may be a closer one)
gui.burmaldaholic.worldgen.locate.click_: Click to put a teleport command in the chat
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.house_table_p: This game belongs to the house and stays in the casino
msg.burmaldaholic.worldgen.dealer.no_tab: This dealer has no table to run
dialog.burmaldaholic.ender_croupier.gree: (The enderman straightens its bow tie and does not look you in the eye. Politely.)
High stakes, quiet voices. Please don't stare.
dialog.burmaldaholic.pit_boss.greeting.1: Snort. I watch the tables. The tables watch you.
dialog.burmaldaholic.pit_boss.greeting.2: Play nice, pay up, and nobody gets bartered.
dialog.burmaldaholic.merchant.greeting.1: Chips burning a hole in your pocket? Have a look.
dialog.burmaldaholic.merchant.greeting.2: Everything here is paid in chips. Even the smile.
